method: llvm-objdump -d --triple=thumbv7-linux-gnueabi; readelf relocations; raw little-endian vtable words

findings.claim: UObjPin::Connect passes this+8, destination and viewer to MWF ObjPin::Connect PLT 0x20588.
R_ARM_JUMP_SLOT resolves the MWF ObjPin::Connect PLT entry.
Generic Connect validates non-null/non-self, matching pin type and compatible direction, then assigns destination; no pre-existing-destination rejection was observed.
Wrapper invokes MWF Connect through 0xca40 when byte this+0x15 is clear; otherwise it defers.
Equivalent wrapper invokes MWF Connect through 0x1540c when not deferred.
Equivalent wrapper invokes MWF Connect through 0xef3c when not deferred.
BizObjPin::Connect adjusts this by four bytes and tail-branches through the imported MWF Connect PLT.
TM::createLifeCycles allocates, constructs LifeCycle at 0x41b6c0 and registers the result via 0x419028.
Itanium vtable address point has Thumb slots 0x41b605, 0x41b649 and 0x41b65d.
Direct caller into 0x41b728 is activation/dispatch-like, but the function name Activate is not retained.
No proven data-flow edge from the created LifeCycle or its observed vtable slots to either Connect PLT exists.
A vtable/static callback is not proof that a callback executes or that it connects pins.

safety: Static read-only analysis only. No original binary altered, no camera connected/flashed, and no SilentShutter functionality claim.
